GENERATE BURST CS-v3-1_4 — cliffside v3 chunk 1_4 by OUTPAINTING (Matt R-C3-46/48). task_id "CS-v3-1_4".

IMAGE 1 is the canvas to EDIT (1536×1024). In it, a 256×256 corner square (from a diagonal neighbour); the LEFT 256 columns (from the chunk to its left); the TOP 256 rows (from the chunk above) are ALREADY PAINTED — real finished pixels from neighbouring chunks. Everything else in IMAGE 1 is a flat-shaded ORTHOGRAPHIC GEOMETRY GUIDE: TAN = packed-dirt cliff-top path; LIGHT GREY band = grassy/rocky verge along the rim; DARK GREY/BROWN plane = the vertical cliff face dropping toward the viewer (paint it as continuous rock all the way down to where it meets the green — it will fade into mist in the game, so keep its lowest part slightly hazier and darker, with no ledge or bottom edge drawn); dark blocks = boulder outcrops; BROWN planks = a wooden bridge deck; MAGENTA plank = one loose bridge plank (paint it as a cracked, loose plank); PURE GREEN #00ff00 = empty void.
Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and deliver ONE 1536×1024 image in which: (a) the painted strip(s) stay as they are; (b) every flat guide area is replaced by painting that CONTINUES the painted strip(s) seamlessly (same colours, textures, stones, grass, strata, light) so no join is visible; (c) every guide boundary stays exactly where it is; (d) every green pixel stays flat pure #00ff00.
Orthographic view: no perspective shrinking toward the top. Scale: a person standing here is 130 px tall. LIGHT: warm SUNSET key from the UPPER-LEFT, cool violet shadows. REGISTER: HAND-DRAWN painted 2D — confident tapered dark contours, painted planes, bold Hades-like jewel tones and graphic shadows — matching IMAGE 2 exactly. No characters, creatures, text, UI, border or vignette.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if a painted strip was altered, a boundary moved, the green was painted over, or a join line remains — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/chunk_1_4.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-v3-1_4"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — the canvas to EDIT (painted strips + geometry guide)
IMAGE 2 — the approved painted STYLE of this level (Matt: 'love the style and the chunks')
